# Changelog ## 0.1.239

This update turns the Geothermal Generator into a real lava station and lets furnaces pick between results from different mods. ### New - **How long the lava lasts.** With the statistics chip, the Geothermal Generator shows how many minutes its lava lasts and its load. It no longer burns lava when the energy has nowhere to go. - **Geothermal advancements.** Three new advancements for the Geothermal Generator: First Lava, Bucket That Pays Off and Station. - **Result button for furnaces.** When another mod's furnace recipe takes the same item, the Electric Furnace and Iron Furnace show a button to pick which result to make. - **Geothermal heat.** A running Geothermal Generator heats the machine standing on it like a lava block, so a Vulcanizer on top needs no other heat. - **Obsidian shavings.** The Geothermal Generator leaves a shaving for every bucket of lava it burns. Nine make obsidian dust, and the Compressor turns the dust into obsidian. - **Cistern Chip.** A new upgrade chip doubles the Geothermal Generator's lava tank to 20 buckets. - **Blaze catalyst.** Blaze powder in the Geothermal Generator's new slot gives 1.5x output and a quarter more energy per bucket of lava, one powder per bucket. - **Lava statistics.** The statistics chip in a Geothermal Generator counts the lava burnt and the energy each bucket gave. ### Improved - **Lava stays inside.** A broken Geothermal Generator keeps its lava in the item and puts it back in the tank when placed again. ### Bug Fixes - **Portal crash.** The game no longer crashes when you look into a portal from a mod that draws another world inside it.

# Changelog ## 0.1.227

This update brings the reactor tablet: watch your whole reactor from 64 blocks away through an antenna in its wall. ### New - **Reinforced Glass Trapdoor.** A steel frame round a see-through glass pane that opens by hand or by redstone, as tough as Reinforced Glass. - Your first dose of radiation earns the "Invisible Dose" advancement: its toast explains the radiation icon and points you to the Geiger counter. Without a signal the tablet shows interference and why. - **The reactor tablet in your hands.** Both hands lift it and its screen unfolds to almost fill the view. Its lamps glow red while the reactor is in danger, even in the hotbar, and it shows its charge.
